h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mirzapur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mirzapur

items.pText: Mirzapur stands where the Vindhya hills meet the Ganga, and in many parts of the district the ground under the topsoil is hard rock. That changes how playground equipment is installed. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory in Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away, and sends it by road to schools, colonies and parks in eastern Uttar Pradesh.

We plan the installation method before anything is manufactured. Send us photos of the ground, tell us whether you have hit rock when digging before, and share the site size and the age group. We will suggest equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and arrange installation with our team or a dealer in north India.

richText.heading: Installing on rocky or uneven ground

c: Where rock lies close to the surface, deep pits for grouting may not be practical. A self-standing installation, where the equipment sits on its own base, can work on firm, level rock or a concrete pad. On uneven ground, level a pad first, because a structure that leans even slightly puts strain on its joints.

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on rocky ground in Mirzapur?
items.a: Yes. Where digging is difficult, we usually suggest a self-standing installation on level rock or a concrete pad, with rubber flooring around it. We decide this from photos of your ground.

items.q: Why does the ground need to be level?
items.a: Equipment that leans puts uneven strain on its joints and can affect how slides and swings work. Level the pad before installation, and check it again after the first monsoon.

items.q: Do you supply eastern Uttar Pradesh?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from our Vasai factory and install through our own team or a dealer in north India.
